[P2] Require coverage for incomplete Converse replies

Every successful Converse fixture includes `stopReason` and text. Removing the `stopReason !== undefined` exception therefore leaves the assertions unchanged. The empty-content fallbacks are also uncovered; together these paths turn `{}` into a checkpointed successful empty answer. This violates CONTRIBUTING rule 4. Return to the response-validation design and either remove these fallback behaviors or add tests requiring the intended outcomes for missing stop reasons and content.
